::: {.obsidian-incident-report}
:::

State the incident in one paragraph. Name the service, the start and
end times, and the overall impact.

# Timeline

Record the incident timeline in chronological order. Use a table
with time, event, and actor columns.

# Root cause

State the root cause of the incident. Separate the direct cause from
any contributing factors.

# Resolution

State how the team restored the service. Name the technical actions
and any customer communication issued.

# Prevention

List the actions that prevent recurrence. For each, name the owner
and the due date. Use a table.
